fusions.name: Off the Spool
fusions.desc: Unspools your tongue at a target up to 6 tiles away for 8 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and wraps it so it moves 30% slower for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Billowing Slough
fusions.desc: Snaps your shed skin outward in a sheet, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 2 tiles, with a 40% chance of [Damped] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Skin Dressing
fusions.desc: Binds your wounds in shed skin, restoring 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Quilted Scales
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
